definitions: The pod of the pea plant, that holds the seeds (the peas) until they ripen
The pod and its contents as a vegetable; the mangetout

blocks.text: Peapod Online Grocer (US), LLC is an American online grocery delivery service. By February 2022, it changed its name to Peapod Digital Labs.
A peapod is a type of small boat traditionally used for nearshore lobstering in Maine, United States. It is a double-ended rowboat usually made of wood. Today they are mainly used as pleasure boats.
